text:
ITEM 1 | Sliced dark-brown meat pieces with browned, seared outer edges and pinkish-red center visible on one cut, slightly glossy, with a few darker crust spots; roughly 10 cm across the cluster, sitting at the upper left of the plate, about 2 cm thick | 150
ITEM 2 | Small chunked grey-brown meat pieces with fibrous texture and darker sear, scattered and partly overlapping item 1, sitting in the center of the plate, about 6 cm across and 1.5 cm high | 70
ITEM 3 | Bright green broccoli florets with dense bumpy tops and slightly darker stems, moist look, clustered along the upper right edge of the plate, about 10 cm long by 4 cm wide, roughly 2 cm high | 80
ITEM 4 | Orange-red carrot pieces, cut into thick rounds and half-moon slices with smooth skin edges and a firm, slightly glossy surface, lying on the right side of the plate, about 9 cm across total, 1.5 cm thick | 90
ITEM 5 | Two rectangular pieces of pan-baked flatbread with golden-brown crisp bottom edges, topped with melted pale-yellow cheese partly browned in spots and red tomato sauce showing through, stacked slightly overlapping at the lower left, each about 7 by 6 cm and 1.5 cm thick | 130
ITEM 6 | Red tomato sauce visible as a thin layer on the cheese topping of the flatbread pieces, moist and slightly glossy with uneven spread, covering roughly a quarter of the flatbread surface | 15
ITEM 7 | Melted pale-yellow cheese covering the flatbread pieces, stretchy-looking with light golden browning spots and small bubbles, covering most of the upper surface of the flatbread at the lower left | 40
